items.text: [table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth="499,188"][td colwidth="499"]
Hey there! It's me Suit-O again with more patch notes!

What did we do this time? Hell if I know. I'm not reading all that. YOU should read it, not me. I've got other stuff to do. But oh man, you look soooo sad. You really don't wanna read the patch notes, do you? You REALLY want me to summarize them quickly for you, huh? Yeah, that's right, you sick puppy. You love it when I read you patch notes, don't you? That's what I thought. Now get on all fours and listen close: we balanced some of the combat and added a feature to pull you out of a soft-lock state, which should never happen anyway because we're perfect game developers who never make mistakes and if you ever end up in a soft-lock it's YOUR fault, not ours, it's because you're bad at playing video games and not because we forgot to make sure you don't clip through that wall if you're holding RT for 12 seconds while at 62% health. Alright, that's enough. I'm bored. You can read the rest on your own, you worm. Suit-O out!!!
[td colwidth="188"]

items.text: [table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth="499,188"][td colwidth="499"]
Hey there, it's me, Suit-O! Again!

I've got more good news for you: Patch 3 is here, baby! You know the "Rule of Threes"? It means every new patch is better than the last! This patch is going to make those last two patches look like crap. But only relatively! Because those were also very good patches. They were NOT crap at ALL. This one's just that much better. So what's in this thing? Oh, who knows. I didn't read it. I'm sure it's all very interesting. Why don't you scroll down and see for yourself? You want me to do everything for you? Because I will! And I do mean everything. But first check out the patch! Suit-O, OUT! I love you! Goodbye!
[td colwidth="188"]

items.text: [table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth="499,188"][td colwidth="499"]
Hey there, Suit-O here!

Guess what? We cooked up a new patch for you. And it's BIG. There's a LOT of stuff in here. I can't even keep track of it all, and I'm a computer. There could be ANYTHING in here for all I know. I'm assuming it's all good helpful stuff but I'm not reading all of this so who knows. I'm just trusting our team. They know what they're doing. So go ahead, update your game and play it some more. It's even better now. We love you very much and we hope you never see another video game bug in your entire life, but if you do then we'll just fix it for you because of how much we love you.
[td colwidth="188"]

items.text: [table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth="499,188"][td colwidth="499"]
Hey there, it's me! Suit-O!

I just wanted to pop in here and say I love you. That's it! That's the whole message. Anyway, have a good rest of your day... oh wait, what's this? Looks like the talented and hot team at Squanch Games just released a new patch for High On Life 2! And it's chock-full of fixes to make your gaming experience even better than it already was!? My god, I didn't even think this is possible. This one's a whopper. I can barely get my little digital hands around it. My gamer readings are off the charts just looking at this stuff! I want so badly to tell you everything in this patch but you should just hurry up and download the update so you can experience it for yourself. You've earned it. You're a superstar. You are loved. You are a good person. You are a capable person. Yes, I'm talking to you right now. No one else can read this. This is a special message for you. Just you. I'm Suit-O. I love you.
[td colwidth="188"]
